hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')"); case "$f" in *package-lock.json|*.lock) ;; *.dart) command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && dart format "$f" >/dev/null ;; *.php) [ -f vendor/bin/pint ] && php vendor/bin/pint --quiet "$f" ;; *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json|*.yaml|*.yml|*.css|*.html) command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1 && prettier --write --log-level silent "$f" ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true

f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')"); case "$f" in *.go) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f go.mod ] || exit 0; out=$(go build ./... 2>&1) || { echo 'go build ./... FAILED — fix before continuing:' >&2; echo "$out" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
